Language: Typescript
Frontend: Astro v5, tailwindcss, soap (npm)
Backend: SOAP WSDL
App idea: The VisionMobile API provides operations related to booking systems, user management, terminal messages, and more.
There are over 30 operations available in the API. So we need to structure the files and folders in a way that makes it easy to manage all the operations.
An API specification is in the file: `API-spec.md`
